title: Explosion prevention and deflagration venting.
officialText:
The structural design and installation of explosion prevention systems and deflagration venting shall be in accordance with the requirements of Appendices E and G of the New York City Fuel Gas Code, as well as the New York City Fire Code, and the rules and regulations of the department.
